originalTitle: Stocks are failing the ‘breadth’ test, but options traders still see reason to buy
summary: An options volatility tracker has produced a “spike peak” buy signal for stocks for the first time in months, at a time that internal market indicators are negative.
content: An options volatility tracker has produced a “spike peak” buy signal for stocks for the first time in months, at a time that internal market indicators are negative.
chineseTitle: 股票未能通过“广度”测试，但期权交易员仍有理由买入
chineseSummary: 在内部市场指标为负的情况下，期权波动率追踪器几个月来首次发出了股票的“峰值”买入信号。
chineseContent: 在内部市场指标为负的情况下，期权波动率追踪器几个月来首次发出了股票的“峰值”买入信号。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
